subject: Web Development
title: What Happens When You Type a URL
description: A fast breakdown of What Happens When You Type a URL for builders.

hook.text: You type a URL and hit enter. In under a second, a full page appears. What just happened?

buildup.text: Your browser looks up the domain, connects to a server, and downloads HTML, CSS, and JS.

discovery.text: It parses HTML into a tree, applies styles, runs scripts, and paints pixels on screen.

twist.text: All of that happens in roughly 100 milliseconds — faster than a human blink.

climax.text: A single page load involves DNS, TCP, TLS, HTTP, parsing, layout, and painting.

punchline.text: A 'simple' page load is an engineering marvel.
